audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3].side and phases[5].side read Skill and phases[6].side reads Aurelion Sol, while content win[3], win[5] and win[6] all read Katarina. Three rows where the chart and the content layer disagree, and phases[6].why describes Katarina's late-game chain reaction under a row awarded to Aurelion Sol.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Katarina x7 at a 56.68% win rate over 995 games, and whys[6] and spikes[3] both say Katarina keeps the 1v1 and the flank — his stacked zone only matters against a grouped team, which is a teamfight caveat, not a lane verdict.
audit.corrected: phases[3], phases[5] and phases[6] sides set to Katarina; the whys on those rows already describe Katarina winning, so they stand.

audit.why: Spikes are right: Katarina's level 3 (Shunpo's 725 range against a 750-range channel), level 6, first item, and a late game where his power is Stardust-gated rather than level-gated. Astral Flight is 22/20.5/19/17.5/16s, so the early cooldown really is long.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it. dontsFull[2] warned about 'spell-shield kits' — Aurelion Sol has no spell shield. Nothing on the page mentioned that Singularity's centre executes below a health threshold and scales off max health, so raw MR or HP stacking is the wrong answer.
audit.why: Riot's E text: the centre of the black hole executes enemies below a percentage of health, and the kit carries both percentHealth ('punishes HP stacking — armour alone is not the answer') and execute flags. Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1, Singularity 12s flat, Falling Star 120/110/100s.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries W 22s, E 12s and R 120s with sequencing; dontsFull[2] rewritten around Singularity's execute centre; tradeBad states the resistance-invalidating interaction.

audit.why: 56.68% over 995 games — the strongest lane in this slice.

edits.before: First item you simply execute him: dagger>E>W>Q>R and no scaling-mage build survives it, so keep long-trading him every wave and finish with ignite. At 2+ items respect only his teamfight: a stacked Q slow-zone plus Falling Star into Skies Descend punishes your team for grouping, so hold your entry until he commits the R and then Shunpo the flank — he still has no answer to you on his face. notes: Chart: three rows disagreed across layers (phases[3] and [5] read Skill, phases[6] read Aurelion Sol, while win[3], win[5] and win[6] all read Katarina and the packet chart is Katarina x7). Sides moved onto the content layer; the whys on those rows already argued Katarina, so no why rewrites and no win[N] pair to edit. Removed a fabricated mechanic: dontsFull[2] and report[11] cited 'spell-shield kits' and Aurelion Sol has no spell shield — replaced with Singularity's execute centre, which also carries the missing interaction (percent-health damage plus an execute threshold, so armour/MR/HP stacking is the wrong answer). Fixed the ability name "Skies Descend" -> "The Skies Descend" in content late; the packet's other two suspect names are false positives. UNVERIFIED: content mid says Breath of Light is 'a channel that stops the moment you Shunpo on top of him', and whys[2] says Shunpo 'cancels his channel value'. Shunpo applies no CC, and Riot's text does not say the channel breaks on damage or on an enemy arriving. I left both strings alone and phrased my own cooldowns line as 'he cannot aim it while you're on top of him', which is true regardless.
